text: たいりょくが　たりません……

patterns.name: 〜が足りない
patterns.span: たいりょくが　たりません
patterns.explanation: The thing you are short of comes before が, and たりません says there is not enough of it. In Japanese the thing itself 'does not suffice', where English says 'I don't have enough'. たいりょくが　たりません = 'there is not enough HP'.
